standard.summary: 按间隔在 [min,max] 内调整有效 rank。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Adjusts the effective rank within [min,max] at a set interval.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 按间隔在 [min,max] 内调整有效 rank。与「Lulynx 实验核心」里的 SmartRank keep_ratio 不同。默认关闭。

advanced_en.principle: Adjusts the effective rank within [min,max] at intervals. Different from the SmartRank keep_ratio in the "Lulynx experimental core". Off by default.
